Allah, whom all creation exalts, sent the unlettered a Messenger from among them to recite His verses, purify them and teach them the Book and wisdom, a bounty from Allah.
Those entrusted with the Torah who did not take it on are like a donkey carrying books; Jews claiming to be Allah's allies are challenged to wish for death.
When called to prayer on Friday, believers must leave trade for Allah's remembrance, then disperse and seek His bounty; some left the Prophet standing for trade or amusement.

The hypocrites swear they believe the Messenger but lie, hide behind oaths, arrogantly refuse his seeking forgiveness for them, urge withholding spending and boast of expelling the humble from al-Madinah.
Believers must not let their wealth and children divert them from remembering Allah, or they will be the losers.
Spend from Allah's provision before death comes and one begs for a brief delay to give charity, for Allah delays no soul when its time has come.
All creation exalts Allah, who owns dominion and praise; He created people, some disbelieving and some believing, created the heavens and earth in truth and perfected human forms.
Allah knows what is in the heavens and earth, what people conceal and declare, and what lies within the breasts.
Earlier disbelievers tasted the result of their deeds because they rejected their messengers' clear evidences, asking whether mere humans would guide them.
Disbelievers claim they will never be resurrected, but they surely will be and will be told what they did, so believe in Allah, His Messenger and the Quran.
On the Day of Assembly, the Day of Deprivation, believers who do righteousness enter gardens with misdeeds removed, while those who deny Allah's verses abide in the Fire.
No disaster strikes except by Allah's permission and He guides the believer's heart, so obey Allah and the Messenger and rely on Allah, besides whom there is no deity.
Some wives and children are enemies to believers, so beware, yet if they pardon, Allah is Forgiving; wealth and children are only a trial, and Allah has a great reward.
Fear Allah as far as able, listen, obey and spend; whoever is saved from his soul's stinginess succeeds, and Allah multiplies a goodly loan and forgives.
Divorce women for their waiting period, keep them housed, retain or part fairly before two witnesses, keep the set term for each case, and spend on pregnant and nursing women.
Many towns that defied their Lord and His messengers were severely punished and lost, so those of understanding should fear Allah, who has sent down the Quran.
Allah sent a Messenger reciting His clear verses to bring those who believe and do righteous deeds out of darkness into light, and into gardens forever.
Allah created seven heavens and of the earth the like of them, His command descending among them, so people know His power over all things and all-encompassing knowledge.
The Prophet forbade himself the lawful to please his wives; after a wife disclosed his secret, two are urged to repent, and all told he could have better wives.
Believers must guard themselves and their families from a Fire fueled by people and stones, kept by stern angels; disbelievers are told that Day that excuses are useless.
Believers are told to repent sincerely so Allah may remove their misdeeds and admit them to gardens, their light running before them as they ask Him to perfect it.
The Prophet is told to strive against the disbelievers and hypocrites and be harsh with them; their refuge is Hell.
Allah's examples: the wives of Noah and Lot, who betrayed their husbands and were told to enter the Fire, and the believing wife of Pharaoh and Mary, daughter of 'Imran.
Blessed is He who holds dominion, created death and life to test who is best in deeds, and made seven flawless heavens, adorning the nearest with stars thrown at devils.
Hell boils and nearly bursts with rage; its keepers ask each company whether a warner came, and they admit they denied him and wish they had listened or reasoned.
Those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and a great reward.
Whether people hide or publicize their speech, Allah knows what is within the breasts, for He created them and is the Subtle, the Acquainted.
Allah made the earth easy to walk and eat from; none is safe from Him making it swallow them or sending a storm of stones, as earlier deniers found.
Only the Most Merciful holds birds aloft, aids and provides; He produced people with hearing, sight and hearts, spread them over the earth and will gather them.
Disbelievers ask when the promise will come; its knowledge is with Allah alone, and when they see it approaching their faces will be distressed.
The Prophet asks who would protect disbelievers from punishment whatever Allah does with him, and declares that he believes in and relies on the Most Merciful.
People are asked who could bring them flowing water if their water sank into the earth.
By the pen, the Prophet is not mad by his Lord's favor; he has an unending reward and a great moral character, and his Lord knows who has strayed.
Do not obey the deniers or the habitual swearer, scorner and gossip, proud of wealth and children, who calls Allah's verses legends; he will be branded on the snout.
The owners of a garden swore to harvest it early, making no exception and keeping the poor out, but found it ruined overnight, admitted their wrong and hoped for better.
The righteous have Gardens of Pleasure; deniers are asked whether Muslims would be treated like criminals, and what scripture, oath or partners support their claims.
On the Day the shin is uncovered, disbelievers called to prostrate will be unable, eyes humbled and disgraced, though they were called to it while sound.
Allah will lead those who deny the Quran gradually to punishment and give them time; they are asked whether a payment burdens them or they know the unseen.
Be patient for your Lord's decision, unlike Jonah, the companion of the fish, who called out in distress; his Lord's favor reached him, choosing him and making him righteous.
Disbelievers nearly make the Prophet slip with their eyes when they hear the message and call him mad, but it is only a reminder to the worlds.
